subject: Materials Science
title: Thermoplastics vs Thermosets
description: A quick, practical guide to Thermoplastics vs Thermosets.

hook.text: Heat a plastic bottle and it melts. Heat a circuit board and it chars. Same word, different beasts.

buildup.text: Thermoplastics soften when heated and harden when cooled — over and over again.

discovery.text: Thermosets cure into a permanent shape — once set, no amount of heat will re-melt them.

twist.text: That permanence makes thermosets ideal for heat shields but impossible to recycle by melting.

climax.text: 90% of plastics produced are thermoplastics — recyclability wins at industrial scale.

quiz.question: Why can't thermosets be recycled by melting?
options: Their cross-links make the shape permanent
